name: NEXUS Blind-30 Confirmatory Recurrent Reasoning Benchmark

teacher_protocol.prompt_rule: Only original question/options are shown to teacher; gold and internal NEXUS state are never shown.

primary_comparisons.R7.17_advisory: exact frozen runtime_r717; final answer remains R7.16 sovereign by manifest
primary_comparisons.R7.17_active: preregistered evaluator changes only the next additional-teacher choice at an R7.16 query point: use frozen R7.17 one-step recurrent suggestion if unused; otherwise fall back to frozen R7.16 BIP39 choice. Formal verifier, initial top2, fusion model, hypothesis-switch threshold, stop thresholds, max cycles and all model weights remain frozen.

secondary_comparison: R7.17 two-step quantum-tree teacher suggestion under the same substitution rule; exploratory but preregistered before teacher inference.
statistical_note: Task-level accuracy plus category/template-cluster summaries are reported; repeated logical families are not treated as 200 fully independent scientific experiments.
